decisive_items: diagnosed as fibrous dysplasia 2 years earlier
findings were reported as suggestive of fibrous dysplasia
ground-glass appearance with homogenous matrix expansion of the frontal bone
response.rationale: Clinical and histopathologic features are characteristic of fibrous dysplasia, with prior similar lesion and biopsy support.

rejected.why: Multiple myeloma was explicitly excluded by absence of CD138+ cells.
SLE history is present but the lesion is not attributed to active lupus, and the patient is well controlled without immunomodulatory therapy.
